resolved.title: 数据类型
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Data Types[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

Before we go any further, it’s a good idea to introduce the main types of data that we use in Python. Each value in Python has a [b]type[/b].

Text, like "Hello world", is called a [b]string[/b].
Whole numbers are called [b]integers[/b].
And numbers with a decimal point are called [b]floats[/b].

Now, we’ve already encountered strings and integers, so you know what that means...Time to float!
[note]Some examples of numbers that are represented as floats are 0.5 and -7.8237591.[/note]

content.text:
在我们进一步学习之前，我们需要先熟悉Python 中使用的主要数据类型。

Python中的每个值都有一个**类型**。

像"Hello world"这种文本，称为**字符串**。
像 1, 2, 30 等整数，称为**整数**。
像 1.2, 0.08, 2.0 等带有小数点的数字，称为**浮点数**。

我们已经学习过了字符串和整数，接下来学习浮点数！

resolved.title: 浮点数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Floats[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

So we know what [b]floats [/b]are, they’re numbers with a decimal, but how do we produce them? 

Well, we can produce a float by dividing any two integers. 
Or we can also run an operation on two floats, or on a float and an integer.

[s0l0!-header][b]Like this:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="3892"]print( 8 / 2 )

print( 6 * 7.0 )

print( 4 + 1.65 )[/code]
[note]A float can be added to an integer, because Python automatically converts the integer to a float. Clever Python![/note]
